aftermath.title: [TODO:de] The Smoke of the Plain
aftermath.text:
[TODO:de] Early in the morning, Abraham gets up and looks down toward Sodom.
He sees dense smoke rising from the land, like smoke from a furnace.
God remembered Abraham, and He brought Lot out of the catastrophe.
